tools.name: moonclerk_list_forms
tools.description: List the MoonClerk payment forms: id, title, currency, payment_volume (cents), successful_checkout_count and created/updated times. Use the form ids to filter customers (plans) and payments. Read-only. GET /forms.

tools.name: moonclerk_get_form
tools.description: One payment form by id: title, currency, payment volume and checkout count. Read-only. GET /forms/{id}.

tools.name: moonclerk_list_customers
tools.description: List MoonClerk customers, which the MoonClerk web app calls "Plans": each is one payer with their subscription (status, plan amount and interval, next payment date, trial and cancel dates), payment method (brand, last 4), coupon discount, custom form fields and the form they used. Filter by form, st

tools.name: moonclerk_get_customer
tools.description: One MoonClerk customer (plan) by id with the full subscription, payment method, discount, checkout amounts (subtotal, fee, total, upfront amount, trial days) and custom field answers. The payer's management link and checkout token are never returned. Read-only. GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: moonclerk_list_payments
tools.description: List MoonClerk payments (charges): date, status (successful, refunded, failed), amount, Stripe fee and amount refunded in cents, currency, payer name and email, payment method, form, customer id (recurring payments only), coupon and custom fields. Filter by form, customer, status or charge-date rang

tools.name: moonclerk_get_payment
tools.description: One MoonClerk payment by id with amounts (cents), Stripe fee, refunds, payer, payment method, Stripe references (charge, customer, invoice), coupon, custom fields and one-time checkout data. The checkout token is never returned. Read-only. GET /payments/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: moonclerk_list_payments · Private data: moonclerk_list_customers, moonclerk_get_customer, moonclerk_get_payment · Public sink: moonclerk_list_payments.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: moonclerk_list_payments · Private data: moonclerk_list_customers, moonclerk_get_customer, moonclerk_get_payment · Public sink: moonclerk_list_payments

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
